items.translation: 通常与 AspectJ 的AnnotationBeanConfigurerAspect一起使用。

items.source: Are dependencies to be injected via autowiring?
items.translation: 需要通过自动装配注入的依赖项是哪些？

items.source: Is dependency checking to be performed for configured objects?
items.translation: 是否需要对已配置的对象执行依赖检查？

items.source: Are dependencies to be injected prior to the construction of an object?
items.translation: 对象的依赖是在对象构建之前注入的吗？

items.source: The name of the bean definition that serves as the configuration template.
items.translation: 作为配置模板的 Bean 定义的名称。
